# Writes pyephem-reference.json for sun.test.mjs. Needs PyEphem (pip install ephem); not used at runtime.
import ephem, json, math, sys
J = 2415020.0 - 2451545.0          # ephem.Date (Dublin JD) -> days since J2000.0
seasons = {}
for y in range(2000, 2051):
    d = ephem.Date(f'{y}/1/1')
    seasons[str(y)] = [round(float(f(d)) + J, 6) for f in (ephem.next_vernal_equinox, ephem.next_summer_solstice,
                                                            ephem.next_autumnal_equinox, ephem.next_winter_solstice)]
obs = ephem.Observer(); obs.lon = '0'; obs.lat = '0'; obs.elevation = 0; obs.pressure = 0
sun = ephem.Sun()
eot = []
d = ephem.Date('2000/1/1 12:00')
while d <= ephem.Date('2050/12/31 12:00'):
    obs.date = d
    sun.compute(ephem.Date(d))                      # geocentric apparent place
    ha = math.degrees(float(obs.sidereal_time()) - float(sun.g_ra))   # Greenwich apparent sidereal time - apparent RA
    e = (ha - 15 * (((float(d) + 0.5) % 1.0) * 24 - 12) + 180) % 360 - 180
    eot.append([round(float(d) + J, 1), round(e * 4, 4), round(math.degrees(float(sun.g_dec)), 5)])
    d = ephem.Date(d + 10)
json.dump({
    'source': 'PyEphem %s: VSOP87 Sun, apparent place (nutation and aberration), Delta T applied; all times UT, as days since J2000.0 (JD 2451545.0)' % ephem.__version__,
    'generator': open(__file__).read(),
    'seasons': 'per year: March equinox, June solstice, September equinox, December solstice',
    'eot': 'every 10th day 2000-2050 at 12:00 UT: [days since J2000, equation of time in minutes (apparent GAST - apparent RA - mean-Sun hour angle), apparent declination in degrees]',
    'seasonInstants': seasons,
    'eotDeclination': eot,
}, open(sys.argv[1], 'w'), separators=(',', ':'))
